text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, as I'm patrolling the tracks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see an Umamusume running silently
alone. I can't
seem to recall how long
she's been out here,
despite patrolling
the area for so long.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's someone I want to catch up to...
so I have
to keep running too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Night always falls while I'm running.
That's why... I
always run... this much.
choice_data_list: Does that mean you've got a goal?
Does that mean you have a goal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leaves the track without another
word. As I
watch her go, something
startling strikes me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe was the only one who
left, but
I'm positive I heard more than
one set of
footsteps walking away...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing that special... There's just
someone
always running ahead of me,
and I want to catch
up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like her clear goal is what
drives her to
be so focused.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Are we done now? My friend has left
already, so
I should go too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she leaves, something startling strikes
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe was the only one who
left, but
I'm positive I heard more than
one set of
footsteps walking away...
